title: sauropus androgynus
intro: Sauropus androgynus, commonly known as Cat's Whisker, is a plant species belonging to the family Haloragaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, pain, and swelling. The bioactive constituents of Sauropus androgynus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
